questions.question:
D1 — Add gstack skill routing rules to CLAUDE.md?
Project/branch/task: gstack-autoplan-chain on main, no CLAUDE.md exists yet.
ELI10: gstack works best when your project's CLAUDE.md includes skill routing rules. These rules tell Claude which gstack skill to reach for when you say things like "ship this" or "find the bug", so you don't have to type slash commands. Without them, skills only run when you invoke them by name.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Without routing, future sessions may skip a helpful skill; with routing, a 15-line section lands in CLAUDE.md (and in plan mode, the write waits until planning ends).
Recommendation: A because routing is a one-time, low-cost setup that makes every later session smoother.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
A) Add routing rules to CLAUDE.md (recommended)
  ✅ Future requests like "review this" or "ship it" auto-route to the right gstack skill
  ✅ Teammates who clone the repo inherit the same routing behavior from the committed file
  ❌ Adds a new CLAUDE.md file and a commit to the repo; in plan mode this is deferred until planning ends
B) No thanks, I'll invoke skills manually
  ✅ Repo stays untouched; no new file or commit is created
  ✅ You keep explicit control over when each skill runs
  ❌ You have to remember and type each /skill name yourself every time
Net: a small committed file versus manual skill invocation forever.
